raw_text: Kashmir Tensions Rise on Article 370 Anniversary as Videos of Alleged Violence Circulate Online. Multiple videos purporting to show Indian security forces committing violence against civilians in Kashmir have gone viral on social media on the anniversary of Article 370 abrogation. Indian officials deny the authenticity of the footage, claiming the videos originate from conflict zones outside Kashmir. Digital forensics experts are examining the footage for signs of manipulation.
clean_text: Geo News reported on viral Kashmir atrocity videos circulating on Article 370 anniversary. Indian officials deny authenticity, claiming footage from other conflict zones. Forensics examination ongoing.
